activeElement._instruction: Enter all the identifiers of the active coil elements or channels.

coilGeometry._instruction: Add the geometry of the coil (e.g., birdcage, loop, Helmholtz).

dimension._instruction: Add the dimension of this coil.

elementCount._instruction: Enter the total number of coil elements.

mountingType._instruction: Add the coil mounting type (e.g., built-in, external, interventional, wearable).

parallelImagingCapable._instruction: Indicate whether the coil supports parallel imaging.

radioFrequencyCoilType._instruction: Add the coil type (e.g., volume, surface, phased array).

targetAnatomyCoverage._instruction: Add the anatomical region(s) the coil is designed to cover.
